description: Department of Co-operative Development - Order made to confer the powers on Mrs. Nawalage Wasanthika Dias from 26.07.2016
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily concerns the conferment of legal powers under specific acts and amendments (Co-operative Societies Law No. 5 of 1972 and its amendments). It involves regulatory matters and the delegation of statutory authority, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, the core content is about legal powers and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
